policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Burkina Faso electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Canada's current Canadian-passport guidance requires a tourist visa and directs the traveller to Visa Burkina; the official portal confirms that the approved electronic visa is emailed before travel.
conditions: Use a Regular Canadian passport, apply and pay online, then print the emailed eVisa for travel. This is electronic issuance, not a border-issued visa or a standalone online form.
Embassy, migration-service, residence, work, transit, special-document, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Republic of Congo advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Canada's current guidance requires an ordinary Canadian traveller to obtain the Republic of the Congo visa from its Ottawa embassy before departure and excludes port-of-entry issuance.
conditions: Obtain the visa from the Embassy of the Republic of the Congo in Ottawa before leaving Canada. The source expressly says it cannot be obtained at a port of entry or at another Congo mission.
Residence, work, study, transit, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Canada's current Canadian-specific guidance says the visa is issued at Félix-Houphouët-Boigny International Airport after pre-enrolment and authority approval before boarding.
conditions: Complete online pre-enrolment and obtain both the receipt and certificate of authority approval before boarding for Abidjan.
The visa is issued at the airport after that preapproval, so this is border issuance rather than an eVisa. ECOWAS, residence, work, transit, diplomatic and special-document routes remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Djibouti electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Canada's current Canadian-passport guidance identifies the Government of Djibouti electronic-visa route; Djibouti's state e-Government guidance confirms that an approved eVisa is emailed to the applicant.
conditions: Use the Government of Djibouti electronic-visa process for tourist, business or transit travel. The approved document is emailed and must be printed; this is electronic issuance, not online pre-enrolment followed by airport issuance.
Work, study, residence, special documents, carrier checks and final admission are excluded.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free visitor access
policies.summary: Canada's current travel guidance says a Regular Canadian passport needs no tourist visa for a Grenada stay of up to 90 days.
conditions: Visa-free for ordinary tourist stays of up to 90 days. Carry a return or onward ticket and evidence of funds if requested.
Long stays, work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Canada's current guidance expressly allows Canadian visitors to obtain a Jordanian visitor or transit visa on arrival at specified airports and border crossings.
conditions: Arrival issuance is available only at international airports, Sheikh Hussein Bridge and Wadi Araba (Aqaba); it is not available at King Hussein/Allenby Bridge.
For Allenby entry, obtain the visa online or through a Jordanian diplomatic mission before travel. Jordan Pass, work, study, residence, transit and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Mali and Niger advance visitor visas
policies.summary: Canada's current guidance expressly requires the ordinary Canadian visitor visa before arrival in Mali and before travel to Niger.
conditions: Obtain the visa before travelling: Mali requires it before arrival, and Niger before travel. This is neither a visa on arrival nor an eVisa merely because an application may be initiated online.
Work, residence, NGO registration, transit, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa-free visitor access
policies.summary: Canada's current guidance says a Regular Canadian passport needs no tourist visa for a North Macedonia stay of up to 90 days.
conditions: Visa-free for ordinary tourist stays of up to 90 days. Presence registration is required within 24 hours, generally by commercial accommodation.
Long stays, work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Paraguay visa-free visitor access
policies.summary: Canada's current guidance expressly says a tourist visa is not required for a Regular Canadian passport visitor to Paraguay.
conditions: This is the ordinary tourist baseline. Return or onward travel evidence may be requested.
Business, student, residence, special-document, minor-travel and final-admission requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Canadian ordinary passports: Sierra Leone arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Canada's current guidance expressly offers a Canadian tourist or business visitor a Sierra Leone visa on arrival as an alternative to applying for an eVisa before arrival.
conditions: For ordinary tourism or business, the source expressly permits either an eVisa before arrival or a visa on arrival; this policy records the available border-issued route.

Other purposes and multi-entry travel require a visa before arrival. The airport security fee and online health declaration are separate from visa issuance; residence, work, study, special documents and final admission remain separate.
